# Mandovyn
> Experimental open-source proof of concept for AI-agent discovery, local permission policy simulation and checksum-only demo receipts. Not production identity or authentication. No A2A, MCP or AuthZEN compliance yet.

## Canonical project
- [Source repository](https://github.com/AbdulkadirKhoujja/mandovyn)
- [README](https://github.com/AbdulkadirKhoujja/mandovyn/blob/main/README.md)
- [Protocol sketch](https://github.com/AbdulkadirKhoujja/mandovyn/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL_DRAFT.md)
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/AbdulkadirKhoujja/mandovyn/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md)
- [Distribution strategy](https://github.com/AbdulkadirKhoujja/mandovyn/blob/main/docs/DISTRIBUTION.md)
- [Benchmarks and limitations](https://github.com/AbdulkadirKhoujja/mandovyn/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md)
- [Security](https://github.com/AbdulkadirKhoujja/mandovyn/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

## What works today
Offline Python simulator: discovery metadata, deny-by-default local demonstration policy, synthetic results, and unsigned SHA-256 consistency-check receipts. No networks, real identities, real consent, or external actions. Reproduce by running: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

## Important exclusions
Not an official OpenID, A2A, MCP or other standards project; not registered as an MCP server; no live A2A Agent Card; no verified credentials; no public production service.
